recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: The mutation engine, the corpus and the bounded-child pattern already exist; the only new thing is the derivation of laws and their confirmation, which is minutes of AST work and seconds of execution. Building a learner first would have produced candidates with no way to tell which were right, which is the failure this measurement exists to quantify.
